answer: Proof-of-stake acts as a rigid horizon against Sybil attacks in AI networks. By requiring a locked capital stake to validate transactions, the system ensures that spinning up a marble of fake identities remains prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale identity fraud faces an opal of diminishing returns, as they must acquire substantial native tokens to exert influence, effectively pegging their illicit power to the tangible economic cost of asset acquisition and network participation.
